t: Electric paint spray gun for use with oil and water-based paints, varnishes, stains and wood preservatives. Adjustable nozzle offers 3 spray patterns for use on different surface areas: horizontal and vertical patterns for larger areas and circular for detailed spraying. Spray width and pressure adjustment for precise spraying. Features telescopic trolley handle with soft grip and 4 castor wheels for excellent mobility. Built-in storage for gun assembly and hose. Adjustable motor speed and paint flow to control the task more accurately. High-volume low-pressure gun increases the proportion of paint reaching the target surface with reduced overspray, material consumption, and air pollution. Quick paint refill.
b: Suitable for Oil & Water-Based Paint & Varnishes
